landing.heroDesc: Seedin is a globally recognized grant initiative providing relief and capital to individuals and entrepreneurs — for business, student loans, mortgages, accident recovery and more. No equity. No payback. Just growth.
landing.fundMoreTitle: We fund more than just businesses.
landing.fundMoreDesc: Whatever season of life you're in, there's a Seedin program for you.
landing.businessCapitalDesc: Launch or scale a small to large business with non-dilutive grants.
landing.studentLoanDesc: Repayment assistance for federal and private student loans.
landing.mortgageAidDesc: Down-payment help, refinancing relief and foreclosure prevention.
landing.accidentReliefDesc: Emergency support for medical bills and accident recovery.
landing.debtRepaymentDesc: Pay down credit card, medical and personal debt with Seedin grants.
landing.familyHousingDesc: Childcare assistance, utility relief and first-home programs.
landing.federallySecuredDesc: Bank-grade infrastructure with end-to-end encryption protecting every applicant.
landing.governmentBackedDesc: Operating as a globally endorsed public-private grant initiative.
landing.nonDilutiveDesc: Pure grants. We never take equity, royalties, or repayment.
landing.ctaTitle: Great things are built by the audacious.
landing.ctaDesc: Your application takes under three minutes. Eligible founders receive disbursement decisions within 14 business days.
